title: Home page
description: The front page: what the business does and where, the credentials a visitor checks, its main services, what customers say, its figures from Site Data, and one way to get in touch.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: The trade and the area, in a few words. Leave it out when the heading names both.
copy_guidance.Heading: What the business does and where, in the words a customer would search with.
copy_guidance.Body: What a first-time visitor gets, and the one thing to do next.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The one action the whole site leads to, such as Get a quote.

copy_guidance.Credential 1: The credential a visitor looks for first, such as a licence, from Site Data's credentials list or as the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: What the business does, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on the kind of work it takes on, or where.
copy_guidance.Service 1 heading: The service most visitors come for, named as Site Data's services list or the site owner names it.
copy_guidance.Service 2 heading: The next service on that list.
copy_guidance.Service 3 heading: The third. Leave the card out when the business offers two.

copy_guidance.Heading: A short question that invites the visitor to take the next step.
copy_guidance.Body: What happens once they get in touch, such as a call back or a visit, as the site owner describes it.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The same action as the hero's button, in the same words.

copy_guidance.Heading: What customers say about the work, in a few words. No count or score.

copy_guidance.Rating label: What the rating is, in a few words, such as Average rating. Name the review site only as the site owner names it.

copy_guidance.Heading: One short sentence that invites the visitor to get in touch.
copy_guidance.Body: How to reach the business, and what happens next.
